firm_data.firm_description: O'Connor & O'Connor, Esqs. is a full service general liability, insurance and corporate litigation firm located in Northport, New York. The attorneys at O'Connor & O'Connor, Esqs. are highly skilled litigators who offer expertise and counseling in the areas of sophisticated construction and labor law litigation, general liability, insurance coverage, products liability and appellate practice.
notable_facts: The firm combines the skill and expertise of larger defense firms with the personal touch and cost cutting abilities of a smaller firm.
O'Connor & O'Connor, Esqs. is committed to actively recruiting and retaining high quality attorneys and paralegals with diverse backgrounds.

email.subject: AI for O'Connor & O'Connor - built for firms like yours
email.body:
Hi Thomas,

Your firm combines the skill and expertise of larger defense firms with the personal touch and cost-cutting abilities of a smaller firm. That's exactly the reality we're built for.

I lead business at Lucio, an AI platform designed for law firms that face BigLaw demands with leaner teams. We recently raised $5M, and firms across 9 jurisdictions have chosen us over Harvey because we focus on what matters to practices like yours: precision, client trust, and efficiency.

Having completed successful pilots on the East Coast, we're now expanding to meet regional firms. I'd be happy to stop by your Northport office on Thursday, April 10 to share how, as ex-lawyers ourselves, we're helping similar firms compete with BigLaw on construction and insurance defense matters.

Worth 20 minutes?

Vasu
Lucio
